interpretation: This analysis uses the 500 provided reviews dated 2025-08-20 to 2026-08-16 to identify the most impactful issues and improvement opportunities, detect controversial features where users are polarized, and specifically examine subscription payment value and workout usability. It will preserve conflicting feedback rather than suppressing it. The available dimensions support segmentation by rating, app version, language, and date; however, country or App Store region cannot be verified, so the US App Store scope is approximated by English-language reviews.
explicitLimitations: No country or App Store region field is available; US App Store cannot be filtered or verified directly.
Language is not a reliable proxy for store region; filtering to English may exclude relevant non-English US reviews or include English reviews from other regions.
Impact and controversy cannot be measured directly from the provided aggregates; they must be inferred from frequency, rating patterns, and sentiment.
Version distribution is fragmented, so version-specific conclusions may have limited sample sizes.
